subject: AWS releases a modular Physical AI Toolchain spanning simulation, policy training and edge deployment
summary: AWS published open reference architectures and deployment automation joining NVIDIA Isaac Sim, GR00T, Cosmos and OSMO with AWS services from data intake through edge deployment. AWS calls the toolchain robot-agnostic and built around portable formats, but it remains AWS-hosted and NVIDIA-native. The announcement does not prove cross-cloud portability, open robot app runtime compatibility or production fleet adoption.
